# Loom

> Loom is an AI trading agent. You describe a market view in plain English — anything from "buy $50 of ETH" to "if funding stays low and price holds, go long" — and Loom turns it into readable rules that trade automatically from your own generated wallet, around the clock.

## What it does
- Turns plain-English theses into readable, backtestable trading strategies
- Backtests any strategy at real market prices before it runs
- Runs strategies 24/7 in three modes: practice ($10,000 at real prices), alerts-only, or live
- Live trading on Solana (token swaps) and Hyperliquid (perps and spot) from a wallet generated at sign-up
- Copy-trading: mirror any Hyperliquid trader's fills with your own size
- Limit orders, stop-loss, take-profit and trailing stops managed automatically
- Public strategy catalog, trader leaderboard and platform revenue transparency
- Email sign-in; no crypto wallet needed to start

## Key pages
- / — overview, live platform stats, how it works, FAQ
- /new — AI strategy builder (write a thesis, get rules, backtest, deploy)
- /strategies — public strategy catalog
- /traders — real Hyperliquid traders with live PnL, with auto-copy
- /leaderboard — live strategy leaderboard
- /revenue — platform earnings, public and on chain
